thesis: The speakers discuss how the company Do Not Pay uses technology to help consumers fight corporations, beat bureaucracy, and sue entities at the press of a button. They explain that the company has resolved over 2 million cases successfully by automating defenses for issues ranging from parking tickets and obscure competition entry laws to securing refunds and handling lost property forms.
